test_title: PYST 32: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Option (1): TPMH**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc36194a422dda920b67c8a6b40121cef5875f9256a1e2eb962d2cf52540b9b5.png] 

**Option (2): AWTO**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1283c9cc26f3ebca501c9c99acd4fa7e0f4809f5af42898421b0ff2236dd7644.png] 

**Option (3): NJGB**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7785d5a7927a2d73771110585dfc9d309cf97b0998af5daa89b632352609aab1.png] 

**Option (4): EAYS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80eaa3cb19c452247e08fb668fb9d4c29ded56a4d861de3a3fbbc75ae5c183de.png] 

The letter-cluster that DOES NOT belong to the group is: **EAYS.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (4)"**
